records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for setting up Quartz Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main thing -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The usual next step is bringing in whoever else is working on that project: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the next step with you and your team's setup.

Best,
Priya
